'''Michael Patton drazins home tropers''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Michael Patton]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-274">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/274 drazins home tropers], DeckTech (michael "R2D5" patton, 26 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/274/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/274/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018231856/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/274/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Patton]]
* '''Published:''' 26 August 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''drazins home tropers''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Arrest Order|Endor-D-imperialarrestorder.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor CCT Patton DS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Mostly drazin special delivery but having stormtropers and blasters.  Effect heavy deck with 10 incuding crosfire do or do not and strategic reserves.

== Original post ==

'''drazins home tropers'''
* '''Author:''' michael "R2D5" patton
* '''Published:''' August 26, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Mostly drazin special delivery but having stormtropers and blasters.  Effect heavy deck with 10 incuding crosfire do or do not and strategic reserves.

=== Strategy ===

Well its based on the drazin game text and special delivery. Keep retriving force while you drain with you troopers all over Cloud City. The 3 ships are in there due to hidden base not to beat it in battle but to find it and and cancel the objective.  Counterattack is a powerful and underrated card that shines in this kind of deck.  There are 3 differnt alterations for this decks starting effects.  There is no try is good aganist any traing deck because they will alter and sense every card you play once its fliped but you still need the arrest order to stop the nabrun leids to drazin.	Security precautions for a hidden base.  Startegic Reserves for opertives but again you still need the arrest ordre. Thanks for your time I am new at this so give me a little break just this once thanks R5D4
